# enVoy (Full Technical & Architectural Reference)

> enVoy by weYou X is an enterprise AI patient engagement and customer communication system. It connects official WhatsApp Business API, voice AI, email, and web chat directly into hospital HMS/EMR and enterprise CRMs to automate 24/7 inquiries, appointment scheduling, reminders, and post-discharge follow-ups.

This is the comprehensive technical reference for enVoy; the executive summary is available at https://weyouenvoy.com/llms.txt

---

## 1. Product Architecture & Overview

enVoy is not an isolated conversational chatbot. It is a full-lifecycle customer communication platform engineered for high-trust, inbound-heavy industries such as healthcare, education, hospitality, and luxury wellness.

The platform consists of four interconnected architectural layers:
1. **Omnichannel Ingress Layer:** Official WhatsApp Business Cloud API, Web Chatbot (Shadow DOM widget), Voice AI Gateway, and Email Parsing.
2. **Natural Language Understanding (NLU) & Triage Engine:** Custom language models fine-tuned on company policies, doctor rosters, clinical specialties, and service catalogs. Capable of mid-conversation code-switching between English, Kannada, Hindi, Tamil, and other regional dialects.
3. **Operational Orchestration Layer:** Bi-directional synchronization engine communicating with hospital management systems (HMS/HIS), electronic medical records (EMR), laboratory information systems (LIMS), enterprise CRMs, and calendar APIs.
4. **Human-in-the-Loop Escalation Console:** An inbox interface where complex, high-priority, or emergency conversations are routed to hospital staff or relationship managers with complete conversational context.

- **Language Coverage:** Any written language — English, Kannada, Hindi, Telugu, Tamil, and Malayalam supported natively
- **System Integration:** Operates on top of existing HMS/EMR/CRM systems (e.g., Cerner, Epic, Kareo, Practo, custom hospital SQL databases, Salesforce, LeadSquared) without replacing core clinical record databases
- **Compliance Certifications:** Aligned with DPDPA 2023 (Digital Personal Data Protection Act India), ISO/IEC 27001 information security controls, HIPAA-grade end-to-end data encryption, and SPDI Rules (IT Act 2000)

## 3. The 9-Stage Hospital Patient Journey

In healthcare deployments, enVoy manages the entire patient experience:
1. **Patient Enquiry:** Instant 24/7 symptom clarification, doctor specialty routing, and clinic timings.
2. **Appointment Scheduling:** Live doctor slot discovery and instant confirmation.
3. **Appointment Confirmation:** Automated WhatsApp confirmation with calendar invites, maps, and directions.
4. **Pre-Visit Communication:** Preparation reminders, fasting requirements for diagnostic tests, and documentation checklists.
5. **Real-Time Queue Updates:** Live token status notifications keeping patients informed and reducing waiting room congestion.
6. **Billing & Discharge Coordination:** Transparent bill breakdowns, insurance TPA documentation assistance, and digital payment links.
7. **Digital Prescription & Report Delivery:** Instant, encrypted delivery of lab reports and doctor discharge summaries via WhatsApp.
8. **Post-Discharge Recovery Follow-Ups:** Automated check-ins on medication adherence, post-surgical recovery symptoms, and vitals tracking.
9. **Patient Feedback & Long-Term Re-engagement:** Structured patient satisfaction surveys, vaccination alerts, and chronic disease annual checkup reminders.

## 4. Frequently Asked Questions (AEO & AI Search Reference)

### What is AI patient engagement software?
AI patient engagement software is an intelligent digital communication platform that connects patients with healthcare providers across channels like WhatsApp, SMS, web chat, and voice. It automates non-clinical administrative tasks including enquiry triage, appointment scheduling, pre-visit instructions, queue management, billing inquiries, and post-discharge follow-ups, reducing staff workload while ensuring patients receive timely care guidance 24/7.

### How does WhatsApp automation work for hospitals?
Hospitals deploy enVoy on their official verified WhatsApp Business number. When a patient sends a message, enVoy's AI understands the patient's intent, queries the hospital's live appointment calendar or HMS in real time, offers available doctor slots, and confirms bookings instantly. Throughout the visit lifecycle, enVoy sends timely reminders, queue alerts, and digital lab reports directly in the patient's WhatsApp thread.

### How can hospitals reduce missed appointments?
Hospitals reduce missed appointments (no-shows) by sending automated, contextual reminders via WhatsApp 24 hours and 2 hours before the scheduled appointment. enVoy allows patients to confirm, reschedule, or cancel with a single tap. Rescheduled slots are immediately released back into the live OPD queue, preserving hospital clinical capacity.

### Can WhatsApp AI integrate with hospital management systems (HMS/EMR)?
Yes. enVoy connects securely to existing HMS, HIS, and EMR databases via RESTful APIs, HL7, or secure database connectors. It reads doctor schedules and writes confirmed bookings, patient contact details, and follow-up notes directly back into the hospital's existing system of record. It does not replace the hospital's HMS or clinical decision-making systems.

### How can hospitals automate post-discharge follow-ups?
After a patient is discharged, enVoy triggers automated, protocol-driven check-ins at predetermined intervals (e.g., Day 3 and Day 7). The AI asks structured recovery questions regarding medication adherence, pain levels, and wound healing. If a patient reports concerning symptoms or high pain scores, enVoy instantly flags the issue and alerts the hospital nursing team or attending physician.

### Is AI patient communication secure and compliant?
Yes. enVoy adheres to India's Digital Personal Data Protection Act (DPDPA 2023), ISO/IEC 27001 information security principles, and HIPAA-grade encryption standards. All patient conversations and health data are encrypted in transit using TLS 1.3 and at rest using AES-256 encryption. Patient consent is collected explicitly, and role-based access controls prevent unauthorized access.

### How long does enVoy take to implement?
enVoy is designed for rapid enterprise deployment and typically goes live within 7 business days from onboarding. The process involves ingesting the provider's specialties, pricing, and FAQs, configuring the WhatsApp Business API number, testing calendar/HMS connectors, and training staff on the human handover dashboard.

### What languages does enVoy support?
enVoy supports all major Indian and international languages. Out of the box, it provides fluent communication in English, Kannada, Hindi, Tamil, Telugu, and Malayalam. It dynamically detects the language or script used by the patient and can switch languages mid-conversation seamlessly.

### How is enVoy different from a regular chatbot?
Traditional chatbots rely on rigid keyword-matching decision trees and button menus that frustrate users when questions deviate from the script. In contrast, enVoy is an operational AI communication system powered by contextual natural language understanding, live bi-directional system synchronization (reading and writing to live calendars/HMS/CRM), and smart escalation to human staff when necessary.
